lines.append(f"Status: {parsed.get('status', parsed.get('reservation_status', ''))}")
lines.append(f"Trip Type: {parsed.get('trip_type', parsed.get('flight_type', ''))}")
lines.append(f"User: {parsed.get('user_id', '')}")

    for i, p in enumerate(passengers):
        if isinstance(p, dict):
            name = f"{p.get('first_name','')} {p.get('last_name','')}"
            dob = p.get('dob', '')
            lines.append(f"Passenger {i+1}: {name} (DOB: {dob})")

# Flights/trips

if isinstance(trips, list):
    for ti, trip in enumerate(trips):
        if isinstance(trip, dict):
            flights = trip.get('flights', [])
            if isinstance(flights, list):
                for fi, fl in enumerate(flights):
                    if isinstance(fl, dict):
                        lines.append(f"Flight: {fl.get('flight_number','')} on {fl.get('date','')} | {fl.get('origin','')} -> {fl.get('destination','')} | Depart: {fl.get('departure_time','')} Arrive: {fl.get('arrival_time','')} | Cabin: {fl.get('cabin','')} | Status: {fl.get('status','')}")

# Baggages
bags = parsed.get('baggages', parsed.get('total_baggages', ''))

    lines.append(f"Baggages: {bags}")

# Insurance
ins = parsed.get('insurance', '')
if ins:
    lines.append(f"Insurance: {ins}")

# Payment
payments = parsed.get('payment_history', parsed.get('payment_methods', []))
if isinstance(payments, list):
    total = 0
    for p in payments:

    if total > 0:

# Created
created = parsed.get('created_at', parsed.get('created_time', ''))
if created:

print("\\n".join(lines))
